description: Procurement slice by agency. One agency slice of the Ni Biashara procurement shelf: active opportunities and recent awards for that agency in one call, counts by record type included. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

agency.description: agency name text, e.g. Veterans Affairs (required)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

name: get_procurement_by_agency
title: Procurement slice by agency
